en: Black‑and‑white postcard image of a tall obelisk monument in a landscaped park or square. At the top of the obelisk stands a large eagle sculpture with wings spread. At the base is an allegorical seated female figure holding a flag or standard, with cannons and decorative elements around her. The pedestal is surrounded by low bollards linked with chains and bordered by flowerbeds. In the background are trees and several multi‑story 19th‑century style buildings. The style suggests a World War I or earlier war memorial.
